name: 401: after Log out in another tab the next request shows the popup, the widgets stay on screen
description: The user logs out in a second tab of the same browser. Back in the first tab a screen change makes the app renew the token, the OIDC provider answers that the session is over and the popup is shown with "No (30s)" and "Yes".

statusMessage: Environment variable [KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USER] does not exist ==> changes the state of the OIDC provider (test users, client token lifetime): run against a disposable Keycloak only
